title: cpa settings
description: Profiles for launching coding agents against a CLIProxyAPI gateway. This schema is where field semantics live: settings files are plain JSON and carry no comments.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, so editors can validate and autocomplete the file.

defaultAgent.description: Agent used when the command line names none, e.g. "claude".

agents.description: Launchable CLI tools, keyed by the name typed on the command line. A name not listed here is treated as an executable on PATH.

bin.description: Executable name or path. Defaults to the agent key.

kind.description: Which variables get injected: ANTHROPIC_*, OPENAI_*, or none beyond the profile's own env.

args.description: Arguments prepended to every launch of this agent.

defaults.description: Applied to every profile. A profile's own env wins on a name clash.

env.description: Environment variables applied to every profile.

claudeSettings.description: Merged into the settings document handed to Claude Code via --settings. Never written to ~/.claude/settings.json.

profiles.description: Named upstream configurations. `cpa profile list` shows them; `cpa profile create` adds one.

agent.description: The one agent this profile is for: a name typed on the command line, e.g. "claude" or "codex", or a key under "agents". Launching the profile with an agent of another kind is an error, since the model slots and settings below mean nothing to it. Omit it and cpa infers "claude" when the profile uses Claude-only fields (models, modelNames, subagentModel, customModelOption, contextWindow, claudeSettings); a profile with none of those fits any agent.

description.description: Free text shown by `cpa profile list`.

apiKey.description: Client key sent upstream. Prefer apiKeyEnv or apiKeyCmd so the secret stays out of the file. The shorthands "env:VAR" and "cmd:shell command" also work here.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the key. Read at launch.

apiKeyCmd.description: Shell command whose stdout is the key, e.g. a password manager lookup. Run at launch.

family.description: Substring matched against the gateway's /v1/models listing. When exactly one model matches, that model fills every slot.

model.description: Catch-all model for any slot not set explicitly.

models.description: Pin slots explicitly. Set, this skips model discovery entirely, so the profile works with the gateway down.

modelNames.description: Human-readable labels for slots in Claude Code's model picker, by slot name.

subagentModel.description: Model Claude Code uses for subagents.

contextWindow.description: Sets CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS for every model in this profile.

customModelOption.description: Surface one model as a hand-picked entry in Claude Code's model picker.

env.description: Extra environment variables for this profile. Overrides defaults.env.

claudeSettings.description: Extra Claude Code settings merged into this profile's --settings document. Never written to ~/.claude/settings.json.

args.description: Extra arguments appended to this profile's launches.
